title: Leaves no imprint.
text: Leaves no imprint.. This was a RIP. No possible way to get a pattern, I've tried several consistencies of dough and not one yielded a recognizable pattern. I am so disappointed and completely unsatisfied. It's cute to look at, that's about it. So sad I spent money on this.
